6910.d: Esiplaanil 4 saani sõitjatega ja hulk inimesi. Taustaks kaks kõrgemat torniga hoonet ja üks väiksem maja. Taevas sinakais roosakais toonides.
6910.de: In the foreground 4 sledges with riders and a number of people. In the background two taller buildings with a tower and one smaller house. Sky in bluish pinkish tones.

7459.d: Mehe rinnapilt peaga en face. Peas hall parukas. Sinise kuue vasakpoolne hõlm ulatub üle rinnal asuva punase paela. Vasakul rinnal aumärk.
7459.de: Bust portrait of a man, head en face. Grey wig on the head. The left flap of the blue coat extends over a red ribbon on the chest. A medal on the left breast.

9014.d: Žanristseen. Ees vasakul, laua ääres, toolil istuv tütarlaps. Seljas maani seelik. Ta vastas küünarnukkidega lauale toetuv laia äärega kübaras meesterahvas. Nende taga paremal selgvaates vanem naine oma ees seisvate meestega žestikuleerides. Ees paremal kassi peale haukuv koer.(eesti)
9014.de: Genre scene. In front on the left, sitting on a chair by a table, a girl. Wearing a floor-length skirt. Opposite her a man in a wide-brimmed hat leaning on the table with his elbows. Behind them on the right, seen frontally, an older woman gesturing with the men standing in front of her. In front on the right a dog barking at a cat.

10068.d: Noore mehe poolportree: pea kerges pöördes vasakule, kere veerandpöördes paremale, mõlemad käed puusas. Mehel hele lokitud parukas, pruunid silmad, sirge nina, ümarad põsed ja punane pruntis suu. Seljas veinipunane vammus, kulla ja hõbedaga tikitud vest ja seotava kaelusega valge särk. Foon ühtlaselt tume.
10068.de: Half-portrait of a young man: head slightly turned to the left, torso in a three-quarter turn to the right, both hands on hips. The man has a light curled wig, brown eyes, a straight nose, round cheeks and a red pursed mouth. He wears a wine-red doublet, a vest embroidered with gold and silver, and a white shirt with a tie-able collar. The background evenly dark.

25464.d: Avatud ukse ees välistrepil põlvitab heledas riietuses laia halli kübaraga noor daam. Teda aitab üles juurdeastunud isa - vanem mees lihtsas pruunis ülikonnas, punase vestiga. Taga seisab käsi kokku lööv ema, tanu peas ja prillid ninal. Paremal seisab isa kuuest kinni hoidev, tõsise näoga väike õde. Lapse peas on roosa paelaga kaunistatud lai õlgkübar ja tal on ees ruuduline põll.
25464.de: In front of an open door, on the outdoor stairs, a young lady in light-coloured clothing and a wide grey hat kneels. She is being helped up by her father, who has stepped closer - an older man in a simple brown suit with a red waistcoat. Behind stands the mother, clapping her hands together, wearing a bonnet and glasses on her nose. On the right stands a small, serious-faced sister holding on to her father's coat. On the child's head is a wide straw hat decorated with a pink ribbon, and in front she wears a checked apron.

25472.d: Piiblistseen Kristuse kiusatusse meelitamisest. Kujutatud on poolfiguuris Kristust veerandpöördega vasemale. Pikad lokkis juuksed, kähar habe, nimbus pea ümber, pahem käsi asetatud rinnale, vaatamas tõsisel pilgul kiusajat. Paremal ees noormees profiilis, palja kaela ja käsivartega, kes pakub Kristusele suurt kullakamakat, mida ta hoiab kahe käega(eesti)
25472.de: A biblical scene of the temptation of Christ. Christ is depicted in half-figure, turned a quarter to the left. Long curly hair, a curly beard, a halo around his head, his left hand placed on his chest, looking at the tempter with a serious gaze. In the right foreground a young man in profile, with a bare neck and arms, offering Christ a large lump of gold, which he holds with both hands

25473.dm: laius: 19.2 cm (plaat); kõrgus: 15.5 cm (plaat); laius: 27.4 cm (leht); kõrgus: 21.9 cm (leht)
25473.d: Piiblistseen Kristuse kroonimisest kibuvitstest pärjaga. Võlvitud ruumis, pildi esiplaanil istub Kristus pikas rüüs, randmed nööriga kokku seotud. Paremal pool seisev noor paljaste jalgadega mees surub Kristusele pähe okaskrooni. Tema liigutus väljendab jõulisust ja ekspressiivsust nii, et Jeesus on surve all kaldunud paremale. Tagaplaanil seisavad turbaniga mees ja vana juut, kes esimesele midagi räägib käega Kristusele osutades. Ees maas asetsevad katki murtud kepi tükid. (eesti)
25473.de: A biblical scene of the Crowning of Christ with a crown of thorns. In a vaulted room, in the foreground of the picture, Christ sits in a long robe, his wrists bound together with a rope. A young barefoot man standing on the right presses the crown of thorns onto Christ's head. His movement expresses force and expressiveness such that Jesus is leaning to the right under the pressure. In the background stand a man with a turban and an old Jew, who is saying something to the former, pointing at Christ with his hand. In front, on the ground, lie the broken pieces of a staff.

25474.dm: laius: 19.5 cm (plaat); kõrgus: 22.0 cm (plaat); laius: 23.6 cm (leht); kõrgus: 26.0 cm (leht)
25474.d: Piiblistseen Iisaku ohverdamisest. Esiplaanil Jakob - pikas rüüs habemik, kes paremas käes hoiab nuga, vasakuga surub alla kivialtaril kõhuli lebava Iisaku pead. Vasakult juurde rutanud lokkis juustega noormees - ingel - on haaranud kinni Jakobi nuga hoidvast käest ja osutab teise käega oinale paremal. Taga suured puud.(eesti)
25474.de: A biblical scene of the sacrifice of Isaac. In the foreground Jacob - a bearded man in a long robe, holding a knife in his right hand, pressing down with his left the head of Isaac, who lies face down on a stone altar. Rushing in from the left, a curly-haired young man - an angel - has grasped Jacob's hand holding the knife and points with his other hand to the ram on the right. Large trees in the background.

25475.dm: laius: 19.7 cm (plaat); kõrgus: 16.7 cm (plaat); laius: 27.0 cm (leht); kõrgus: 21.5 cm (leht)
25475.d: Piiblistseen Neitsi Maarja Jeesuslapsega avara maastiku foonil. Maarja on poolfiguuris, keha poolpöördes paremal, nägu en face. Ilme rahulik, pilk langetatud, siledad juuksed lahku kammitud, rüü jätab kaela vabaks, üle pea on heidetud kerge loor. Jeesuslaps on ema käte vahel alasti, laps vaatab otse, pahema käega toetub ema rinnal, keha pöördes vasakule. (eesti)
25475.de: A biblical scene of the Virgin Mary with the Christ Child against the background of an expansive landscape. Mary is shown as a half-figure, her body turned half-way to the right, her face en face. Her expression is calm, her gaze lowered, her smooth hair parted, her robe leaves the neck bare, a light veil thrown over her head. The Christ Child is naked in his mother's arms, the child looks straight ahead, leaning with his left hand on his mother's breast, his body turned to the left.

25476.dm: laius: 19.0 cm (plaat); kõrgus: 21.0 cm (plaat); laius: 23.5 cm (leht); kõrgus: 26.0 cm (leht)
25476.d: Piiblistseen: Kristuse ristilt mahavõtmine. Maastiku foonil paikneva risti jalamil nutavad neli naist hoides Kristuse elutut keha. Laip on poollebavas asendis linal, kätes ja jalgades naelaaugud, küljes haav, pea ümber nimbus. Risti jalami juures istub Neitsi Maarja tumedas rüüs, toetades parema käega Kristuse ülakeha oma põlvede vastu. Keskel hoiab üks naine kahe käega Kristuse vasakut kätt ja suudleb seda. Paremal ees hoiab üks naine põlvedel Kristuse jalgu, ise nuttes rätikut silmadele surudes. Tema taga kaebleb kummargil vana naine, käed ristamisi. Grupi taga, keskel seisab mees käed laiali. Risti taga nutab veel üks naine. Vasakul taga paistab linn. Esiplaanil maas okaskroon ja jämedad
25476.de: Biblical scene: the Descent of Christ from the Cross. At the foot of the cross, set against a landscape background, four women weep, holding Christ's lifeless body. The corpse is in a half-suspended position on a cloth, with nail wounds in the hands and feet, a wound in the side, a halo around the head. At the foot of the cross sits the Virgin Mary in a dark robe, supporting Christ's upper body against her knees with her right hand. In the middle one woman holds Christ's left hand with both hands and kisses it. In the foreground on the right one woman holds Christ's feet on her knees, weeping and pressing a cloth to her eyes. Behind her an old woman laments, bent over, hands crossed. Behind the group, in the middle, a man stands with arms spread. Behind the cross another woman weeps. In the background on the left a town can be seen. In the foreground on the ground a crown of thorns and thick

25477.dm: laius: 15.8 cm (plaat); kõrgus: 20.8 cm (plaat); laius: 23.6 cm (leht); kõrgus: 26.2 cm (leht)
25477.d: Esiplaanil risti raskuse all mahavajunud Kristus, kes toetub kahe käega maapinnale ja tõstab okaskrooniga pead, näol valulik ilme. Tagant on juurde astunud mees, kes on haaranud kahe käega ristist, et seda kergitada. Vasakul pool astuv rooma sõjamees soomussärgis? ja kiivris, kepp käes, keelab teda. Teine kiivriga sõdur, paremal, hoiab vasaku käega Kristuse külge kinnitatud köit, mille otsa on ta parema käega tõstnud löögiks. Tagaplaanil mees turbaniga, teine redeliga, üks rooma sõdur ratsa, teine kilbi ja odaga. (eesti)
25477.de: In the foreground, Christ sunk down under the weight of the cross, supporting himself on the ground with both hands and raising his head crowned with thorns, his face bearing a pained expression. A man has stepped up from behind and grasped the cross with both hands to lift it. On the left a Roman soldier stepping forward, in armor(?) and helmet, staff in hand, forbids him. Another helmeted soldier, on the right, holds with his left hand a rope attached to Christ, the end of which he has raised with his right hand for a blow. In the background a man with a turban, another with a ladder, one Roman soldier on horseback, another with a shield and spear.

25478.dm: laius: 19.5 cm (plaat); kõrgus: 46.5 cm (plaat); laius: 21.5 cm (leht); kõrgus: 27.3 cm (leht)
25478.d: Piiblistseen: evangelist Johannesele toob kotkas sule kirjutamiseks. Johannes - ümara näoga, pikkade lokkis juustega noormees - on kujutatud poolfiguuris, käes raamat ja paberirull. Mees vaatab üles kotka poole. Vasakul asetsevas karikas tõstab uss pead.(eesti)
25478.de: A biblical scene: an eagle brings a quill to the Evangelist John for writing. John - a round-faced young man with long curly hair - is depicted in half-figure, holding a book and a scroll. The man looks up towards the eagle. In the cup placed on the left, a snake raises its head.

25480.dm: laius: 19.6 cm (plaat); kõrgus: 15.0 cm (plaat); laius: 27.5 cm (leht); kõrgus: 22.0 cm (leht)
25480.d: Alasti Jeesuslaps lebab linaga kaetud asemel, ülakeha toetumas padjale. Ta sirutab käed emale vastu, kes temalt on tõstnud katte. Maarja vaatab hardunud ilmega lapsele, hoides mõlema käega katet. Vasakul taga seisab habemik Joosep nõjatudes kahe käega pikale kepile ja vaadates samuti last. Nii Maarja kui Joosepi pea ümber särab nimbus. Fooniks tume draperii.(eesti)
25480.de: The naked Christ child lies on a bed covered with linen, his upper body resting on a pillow. He reaches out his arms toward his mother, who has lifted the cover from him. Mary looks at the child with a devout expression, holding the cover with both hands. On the left in the background stands the bearded Joseph, leaning with both hands on a long staff and likewise looking at the child. Both Mary's and Joseph's heads shine with a halo. The background is a dark drapery.

25481.dm: laius: 19.4 cm (plaat); kõrgus: 18.2 cm (plaat); laius: 23.7 cm (leht); kõrgus: 26.2 cm (leht)
25481.d: Keskel ees Maarja parempoolses profiilis, parem käsi sirutatud ette. Paremal istub padjal Jeesuslaps, põlvedel avatud raamat, parema käe näpp suus. Johannes poisikesena tagapool profiilis vaatab Jeesust, osutades näpuga lehele raamatust. Fooniks draperii.(eesti)
25481.de: In the middle foreground, the Virgin Mary in right profile, her right hand outstretched forward. On the right, sitting on a cushion, the Christ Child, an open book on his knees, the finger of his right hand at his mouth. John as a boy behind, in profile, looking at Jesus, pointing with his finger at the page of the book. The background is a drapery.

25506.dm: laius: 26.0 cm (plaat); kõrgus: 24.5 cm (leht); laius: 31.5 cm (leht); kõrgus: 20.0 cm (plaat)
25506.d: Sünge siseruum, kus istub viletsates riietes hallipäine habemega vanamees. Tema juurde on astunud paljaste jalgadega heledates riietes noor tütarlaps kes embab meest. Vanamees sirutab talle käed vastu. Taamal kamin hingitseva tulega. Esiplaanil kiviparkettpõrandal korv ja kann. (eesti)
25506.de: A gloomy interior, in which sits a grey-haired, bearded old man in shabby clothes. A young girl with bare feet, in light-coloured clothes, has come up to him and embraces the man. The old man stretches his arms out to her. In the background a fireplace with a dying fire. In the foreground, on a stone-paved floor, a basket and a jug.

29879.d: Keskel suur puu, mille okstele heidetud telki moodustav riie. Selle all laud, pink ja palvetava naise figuur. Esiplaanil paremal halli habemega istuv vana mees, kellest vasakul pool põlvitab noor naine, paremal mees, nende käed kokkupanduna vanamehe põlvedel. Üldkoloriit hallikas pruun.
29879.de: In the centre a large tree, over whose branches a cloth thrown to form a tent. Beneath it a table, a bench and the figure of a praying woman. In the foreground on the right a seated old man with a grey beard, to his left a young woman kneels, on the right a man, their hands clasped together on the old man's knees. Overall colouring greyish brown.
